text: 70-year-old woman. The patient presents with sudden episodes of dizziness that are position dependent. She describes experiencing a false sensation of motion and occasional spinning, indicative of vertigo. She denies any recent illnesses, injuries, or significant changes in health status, apart from age-related hearing loss (presbycusis).

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detail; the position-dependent nature of your spinning sensation is very concerning for benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV). DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

Based on your history of position-dependent vertigo without other neurological deficits or acute hearing loss, this presentation is classic for BPPV. We will proceed with a bedside examination to confirm the diagnosis and identify the affected canal.
